paint.def: a colored liquid that you put on things with a brush
paint.ex: I used red paint on the picture.

republic.def: a country where people vote for the leader
republic.ex: In a republic, people vote for their leader.

reserve.def: to keep something for someone to use later
reserve.ex: We reserve a table at the restaurant.

row.def: a line of things side by side
row.ex: The ducks swam in a row.

salt.def: white grains that make food taste better and are found in the sea
salt.ex: I put salt on my eggs.

scare.ex: The loud noise can scare the cat.

scottish.ex: We heard Scottish music at the fair.

statistics.def: numbers that tell facts about something
statistics.ex: The statistics show how many fish are in the lake.

switch.def: a small button that turns something on or off
switch.ex: I flip the switch to turn on the light.

territory.def: an area of land that belongs to a person, animal or country

threat.def: a sign that something bad might happen
threat.ex: Dark clouds are a threat of rain.

wales.def: a country that is part of the United Kingdom
wales.ex: Wales has green hills and a long coast.

appoint.def: to choose a person for a job
appoint.ex: The class will appoint a helper.

aside.def: to one side or out of the way
aside.ex: I put my book aside to eat.

assistance.def: help that you give or get
assistance.ex: I asked the teacher for assistance.

bell.def: a metal object that rings when you hit it
bell.ex: The school bell rings at noon.

blow.def: to push air out of your mouth

bond.def: a close tie between people or animals

boyfriend.def: a boy or man who is someone's special loving friend
boyfriend.ex: Her boyfriend gave her a flower.

careful.def: thinking about what you do so nothing goes wrong
careful.ex: Be careful with the glass cup.

circumstances.def: the facts and events around a situation

communications.def: ways of sending information, like phones and the internet

corporation.def: a big company with many workers

cry.def: to have tears come from your eyes

danger.def: the chance that someone could get hurt
danger.ex: The sign warns of danger near the water.

delivery.def: bringing something to a person or place

deserve.def: to have earned something because of what you did
deserve.ex: You deserve a snack after your hard work.

devices.def: small machines made for special jobs

folks.def: a word for people in a group

gender.def: being a boy or a girl, or something in between

instance.ex: A dolphin is an instance of a sea mammal.

motion.def: moving from one place to another

prize.def: a thing you get for winning or doing well
prize.ex: I won a prize for my drawing.

reasonable.ex: It is reasonable to wear a coat in snow.

register.def: to put your name on a list

resolution.ex: My resolution is to read every day.

rural.def: about the countryside, not the city
rural.ex: We live in a rural area with farms.

sing.def: to make music with your voice

spain.ex: Spain is a warm country by the sea.

tool.def: a thing that helps you do a job

typical.def: just like most others of its kind

universe.def: all of space, with every star and planet

warn.def: to tell someone about something that might hurt them
warn.ex: The sign will warn us about the hot stove.

admit.def: to say that something is true, often when it is hard to say
admit.ex: I admit I ate the last cookie.

attitude.def: the way you think and feel about something
attitude.ex: She has a happy attitude about school.

branch.def: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk
branch.ex: A bird sat on the branch.

brazil.def: a big country in South America
brazil.ex: Brazil has a huge green rain forest.

conduct.def: to lead or carry out something
conduct.ex: The teacher will conduct the music class.

dedicate.def: to give your time and effort to something special
dedicate.ex: I dedicate my song to my grandmother.

definition.def: the words that tell what a word means
definition.ex: The dictionary gives a definition of each word.

favor.def: a kind thing that you do to help someone
favor.ex: Can you do me a favor and pass the salt?

flag.def: a piece of cloth with colors or a picture that stands for a country or group
flag.ex: The flag waves in the wind.

frame.def: a border around a picture or window

guest.def: a person who is invited to your home or party

heaven.def: a place where some people believe good people go after they die

independence.def: being free and able to do things on your own
independence.ex: I like my independence when I tie my shoes.

institution.def: a big organization such as a school or hospital
institution.ex: A school is an institution for learning.

kiss.def: a gentle touch with the lips to show love
kiss.ex: I gave my mom a kiss.

load.def: the things that are carried at one time

plot.def: the events that happen in a story

possibility.def: something that might happen or be true

recovery.def: getting well or strong again after being sick or hurt
recovery.ex: My quick recovery let me go back to school.

rent.def: to pay money to use something that belongs to someone else
rent.ex: We rent a boat for the day.

replace.def: to put a new thing in the place of an old one
replace.ex: I replace the old battery with a new one.

represent.def: to stand for or be a sign of something
represent.ex: The heart shape can represent love.

senator.def: a person chosen to help make laws for a country or state
senator.ex: The senator spoke to the class.

sentence.def: a group of words that tells a complete idea
sentence.ex: I wrote a sentence about my dog.

teeth.def: the hard white parts in your mouth that you use to bite and chew
teeth.ex: I brush my teeth every night.

tip.ex: The tip of my pencil is sharp.

academic.ex: She does well in academic subjects.

academy.def: a school that teaches a special subject
academy.ex: My sister goes to a music academy.

achieve.def: to do or get something after trying hard
achieve.ex: I will achieve my goal of reading ten books.

afford.def: to have enough money to buy something
afford.ex: We can afford to buy a new bike.

assume.def: to think that something is true without being sure
assume.ex: I assume it will be sunny today.

bottle.def: a tall container for liquids, with a narrow top
bottle.ex: I filled my bottle with water.

bunch.def: a group of things that are together
bunch.ex: I picked a bunch of flowers.

category.def: a group of things that are alike

chat.def: to talk in a friendly and relaxed way

cheese.def: a food made from milk that can be soft or hard
cheese.ex: I like cheese on my sandwich.

chemical.def: a substance used in science or to clean

competitive.ex: My brother is competitive in games.

diet.def: the food that a person or animal usually eats

fruit.def: a sweet food that grows on plants, like an apple or banana

index.def: a list at the end of a book that shows where to find things
index.ex: I used the index to find turtles.

lane.def: a narrow road or a path for one line of traffic

mess.ex: The toys made a mess on the floor.

navy.def: a group of people and ships that protect a country at sea

normally.ex: I normally wake up at seven.

occur.ex: Rain can occur in any season.

opposition.def: people or a group who are against something
opposition.ex: There was no opposition to the plan.

permanent.def: lasting for a very long time without changing
permanent.ex: The tree is a permanent part of the yard.

personally.ex: Personally, I like the red one.

pleasure.ex: It is a pleasure to meet you.

prefer.def: to like one thing more than another

programme.def: a show on television or radio
programme.ex: We watched a programme about turtles.

representative.def: a person chosen to speak or act for a group
representative.ex: Our class representative spoke at the meeting.

scheme.ex: We made a scheme for the garden.

shift.def: to move something from one place to another
shift.ex: Please shift your chair closer to the table.

storage.def: a place or way of keeping things until you need them
storage.ex: We keep the toys in storage.

tank.def: a large container that holds liquid or gas
tank.ex: The fish live in a big tank.

tend.ex: Cats tend to sleep in the sun.

tight.def: fitting very close or held firmly

transportation.def: ways of moving people or things, such as buses and trains
transportation.ex: A bus is a type of transportation.

ultimately.ex: Ultimately, we found the lost cat.

unlike.ex: Unlike a fish, a cat has fur.

weekly.def: happening one time in each seven days

yard.def: the open space next to a house
yard.ex: The dog plays in the yard.

assets.def: things of value that a person or business owns
assets.ex: The farm's assets include a barn and tractors.

basketball.def: a game where players throw a ball into a high hoop

button.def: a small round thing on clothes or a machine that you push or fasten
button.ex: Push the button to start the music.

combat.def: a fight between people or armies
combat.ex: The museum has a book about combat.

constitution.def: the set of main rules for how a country is run

consumer.def: a person who buys and uses things

counter.def: a flat top where you put things or are served in a shop

creation.ex: This clay turtle is my creation.

crown.def: a shiny circle worn on the head by a king or queen
crown.ex: The queen wore a gold crown.

define.def: to tell what a word means
define.ex: The dictionary will define the new word.

depend.def: to need something or someone for support
depend.ex: Plants depend on water to grow.

depression.def: a sickness where a person feels very sad for a long time
depression.ex: A doctor can help with depression.

employment.def: having a job that you are paid for
employment.ex: He found employment at the bakery.

exclusive.def: only for a certain person or group

excuse.def: a reason that you give to explain a mistake

frequently.ex: We frequently walk by the sea.

golf.def: a game where you hit a small ball into holes with a club
